chapter.heading: A Call to Repentance
chapter.v:
Come,and let
us return to the Lord;For He has torn, but He will heal us;He has stricken, but He will bind us up. [Acts 7:57; 8:1, 3; 26:10, 11; Gal. 1:13; 1 Tim. 1:13]

After two
days He will revive us;On the third day He will raise us up,That we may live in His sight. [Acts 22:5]

Let us
know,Let us pursue the knowledge of the Lord.His going forth is established as the morning;He will come to us like the rain,Like the latter and former rain to the earth.Impenitence of Israel and Judah [Acts 22:6; 26:12, 13; 1 Cor.]

“O Ephraim,
what shall I do to you?O Judah, what shall I do to you?For your faithfulness is like a morning cloud,And like the early dew it goes away. [[Matt. 25:40]]

Therefore I
have hewn them by the prophets,I have slain them by the words of My mouth;And your judgments are like light that goes forth.

For I
desire mercy and not sacrifice,And the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

“But like
men they transgressed the covenant;There they dealt treacherously with Me. [Dan. 10:7; John 12:29; [Acts 22:9;]

Gilead is
a city of evildoersAnd defiled with blood.

As bands
of robbers lie in wait for a man,So the company of priests murder on the way to Shechem;Surely they commit lewdness.

I have
seen a horrible thing in the house of Israel:There is the harlotry of Ephraim;Israel is defiled.

Also, O
Judah, a harvest is appointed for you,When I return the captives of My people. [Acts 21:39; 22:3]
